    if action != 6:
        return new_grid

    S1 = [38,39, 37, 36, 35, 33,34, 32, 31, 29,30, 28, 27, 26, 24,25, 23, 22, 20,21, 19, 18, 17, 15,16, 14, 13, 12, 10,11, 9, 8, 6,7, 5, 4, 3, 1,2, 0]
    S2 = [63, 61,62, 60, 59, 58, 56,57, 55, 54, 52,53, 51, 50, 49, 47,48, 46, 45, 44, 42,43, 41, 40]
